body: Thursday: the trial crew left their work shirts in the spare room. The sharp smell reached the kitchen, and the dog was sick before the road patrol arrived.
title: The room nobody wanted
gloss: A personal trace places field-program residue before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have encountered the same residue while responding; the personal trace does not by itself prove the field program caused the emergency.

body:
They gave us a count for the beds and told us it was final. Then another family arrived at the back door with a child too tired to stand.

We made room and I put her shoes under the bed so nobody would trip. In the morning the list still had the old count. A visitor looked at the shoes and asked us to move them before the next inspection.

The child did not understand why her mother kept calling her by a different name. I did, but I did not tell her.
title: The extra occupant
gloss: A scene-specific count or record was controlled while people were still present.
rival_reading: The same trace could follow an investigation of contaminated farm goods or an ordinary emergency response.
